author: brossow
releaseNotes: Multi-unit accounts: every thermostat or water heater on the account is listed on the device page, one per state variable, and a device is pinned to a physical unit by serial number. The serial fills itself in on first connect, and upgrades from 0.1.x migrate the old index setting automatically. Selection that can't be resolved logs an error and controls nothing rather than falling back to the first unit.
